decisions.question: q-105200

authoring.question: q-105200
authoring.value:
The difference $Z∖Y$ consists of all the elements that are in $Z$ but not $Y.$ To represent $Z∖Y,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $Z$ but not $Y.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14037357/assets/45a15beb8833e2974706a04b0cdfd81dcdda4b92323f0c092683b9882e53b0ea.png)

The elements $♠$ and $♢$ are in $Z$  but not $Y.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
Z∖Y={♠,♢}.
$$

authoring.value:
The difference $Y \setminus X$ consists of all the elements that are in $Y$ but not $X.$ To represent $Y \setminus X,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $Y$ but not $X.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14037357/assets/5461edca3823f1cafd9f7b51528cd6eb1035e38f7f94c60177e369e2cdd5f350.png)

The only element in $Y$ that is not in $X$ is $4.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
Y \setminus X = \{ 4 \}.
$$
